title: Carolle S NDE 1019
content: I was with my aunt in the Pacific Ocean. I was on an inner tube and she was pushing me out until the water came to her neck. When she went to turn around and head back to shore, a wave picked up the tube and dumped me to the bottom. She kept reaching for me but couldn't find me. I just sat on the bottom and my short life started going before my eyes. Birthday parties, Christmas - mostly good memories, I don't remember any bad memories at that time. My aunt finally found me and when she touched me, the memories stopped. She pulled me up by my hair and she was crying.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Threat from drowning.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I could see myself from above and a little behind. So I was looking at the crown of my head and watching my hair float around.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was very alert and conscious the whole time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I remember a roaring sound, but at the time I thought it was the ocean.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes The tunnel came before me when the memories were coming to an end. At that time, my aunt reached me and I didn't enter the tunnel, but I saw it. By the way, the memories were in chronological sequence, so I knew when they were going to stop because they were getting closer to that day.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light was in the tunnel and was very bright, warm and inviting.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes At the time I was only six and had never experienced or heard of anything like this happening. Everyone around me was upset and frightened and I didn't tell anyone at the time what had happened.
